member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.dcplx.mat_col_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.ComplexMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.ComplexMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.dcplx.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.ComplexMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.ComplexMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, P', Q and R such that PAP' = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P and P' are permutation matrices, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.dcplx.mat_cod_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.ComplexMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.ComplexMat)
member.summary: Returns a rank-revealing complete orthogonal decomposition (COD) of the general matrix matA This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. A may be rank deficient. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.dreal.mat_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.DoubleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.DoubleMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices Q and R such that A = QR by using Householder transformations. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.dreal.mat_col_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.DoubleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.DoubleMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.dreal.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.DoubleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.DoubleMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, P', Q and R such that PAP' = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P and P' are permutation matrices, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.dreal.mat_cod_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.DoubleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.DoubleMat)
member.summary: Returns a rank-revealing complete orthogonal decomposition (COD) of the general matrix matA This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. A may be rank deficient. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.ocplx.mat_col_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.OctupleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.OctupleMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.ocplx.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.OctupleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.OctupleMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, P', Q and R such that PAP' = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P and P' are permutation matrices, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.ocplx.mat_cod_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.OctupleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.OctupleMatC)
member.summary: Returns a rank-revealing complete orthogonal decomposition (COD) of the general matrix matA This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. A may be rank deficient. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.qcplx.mat_col_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.QuadrupleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.QuadrupleMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.qcplx.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.QuadrupleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.QuadrupleMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, P', Q and R such that PAP' = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P and P' are permutation matrices, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.qcplx.mat_cod_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.QuadrupleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.QuadrupleMatC)
member.summary: Returns a rank-revealing complete orthogonal decomposition (COD) of the general matrix matA This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. A may be rank deficient. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.scplx.mat_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.SingleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.SingleMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices Q and R such that A = QR by using Householder transformations. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.scplx.mat_col_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.SingleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.SingleMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.scplx.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.SingleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.SingleMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, P', Q and R such that PAP' = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P and P' are permutation matrices, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.scplx.mat_cod_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.SingleMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.SingleMatC)
member.summary: Returns a rank-revealing complete orthogonal decomposition (COD) of the general matrix matA This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. A may be rank deficient. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.sreal.mat_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.SingleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.SingleMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices Q and R such that A = QR by using Householder transformations. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.sreal.mat_col_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.SingleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.SingleMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.sreal.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.SingleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.SingleMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, P', Q and R such that PAP' = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P and P' are permutation matrices, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.sreal.mat_cod_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.SingleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.SingleMat)
member.summary: Returns a rank-revealing complete orthogonal decomposition (COD) of the general matrix matA This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. A may be rank deficient. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.oreal.mat_col_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.OctupleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.OctupleMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.oreal.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.OctupleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.OctupleMat)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, P', Q and R such that PAP' = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P and P' are permutation matrices, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.oreal.mat_cod_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.OctupleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.OctupleMat)
member.summary: Returns a rank-revealing complete orthogonal decomposition (COD) of the general matrix matA This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. A may be rank deficient. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.qreal.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.QuadrupleMat,System.String,FixedPrecNet.QuadrupleMat)

See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.ecplx.mat_col_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.ExtendedMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.ExtendedMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, Q and R such that AP = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P is a permutation matrix, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs column pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.

member.name: M:FixedPrecNet.ecplx.mat_full_piv_householder_qr(FixedPrecNet.ExtendedMatC,System.String,FixedPrecNet.ExtendedMatC)
member.summary: Returns the QR decomposition of a matrix A into matrices P, P', Q and R such that PAP' = QR by using Householder transformations. Here P and P' are permutation matrices, Q a unitary matrix and R an upper triangular matrix. This decomposition performs full pivoting in order to be rank-revealing and improve numerical stability. See the manual for details regarding the results.
